1.bug_analyze: The issue is that in Visual Basic a comment starting with an apostrophe (') may be continued onto the next line using the line-continuation token (_) and should all be treated as a single comment token. In the buggy rendering only the first line (up to the underscore) is shown in comment color, while the continued second line is lexed as code—highlighting keywords like Title and Default rather than remaining in the comment color. The correct behavior is for the editor to recognize the underscore on a commented line as extending the comment, so that both lines appear entirely in the comment color.
1.patch_analyze: In the patched screenshot both the original comment line and its continuation line are rendered in the comment color (grey) with no VB keywords highlighted on the second line. This matches the expected behavior of treating the line continuation under a comment as part of the same comment token.
